items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I would have Little Richard's band on this side, have my band on this side... I had the three bands together.

ctx.x: Five or six pieces. I remember, I opened up on the stage, big stages in ______, Atlanta, and I would have Little Richard's band on this side, have my band on this side, and the girl band right in the middle. So, that included about 17, 18 pieces.
: Well, I mean, did you all play together?
